text:
zoe: Heads-up for weekly KPI: dashboard shows inbound leads +40% from launch posts but CRM revenue not matching. Link: https://app.redwood.com/dash/launch-kpi. Can analytics sanity-check attribution and webhook errors?

matt: Seeing mismatch between GA events and CRM because our webhook retrier dropped some payloads last night during a 2m window. devops-bot logged 502 spikes.

devops-bot: incident: webhook-proxy returned 502 for 2m at 2026-03-10T23:18:00Z. retries=3 -> dropped=124.

anya: If 124 leads dropped from ingestion they probably landed as "unknown" in the dashboard. Running cohort pull for last 48h.

analytics: quick numbers: total leads (48h)=2,050; dashboard-attrib=1,712; gap=338. Suspect 124 webhook drops plus ~214 from a malformed utm param on the webinar CTA.

zoe: Can we isolate the webinar CTA malformed utm by landing path? That explains the big lift but low revenue.

matt: Yep. The CTA uses utm_campaign=webinar-launch but we found encoded spaces in some requests: utm_campaign=%20webinar-launch vs webinar-launch -> ingestion maps %20-prefixed to 'unknown_campaign'. Working on a fix to normalize.

anya: SQL sample used: ```SELECT id, created_at, landing_path, utm_campaign FROM leads WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '48 hours' AND (utm_campaign LIKE '%20%' OR source='unknown') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;```

analytics: Simulated backfill (normalize utm, replay webhook for dropped ids) yields: dashboard-attrib-adjusted=2,044 (so only 6 residual unknowns), revenue_attrib_adjusted aligns with baseline. I'll attach chart to the KPI deck.

zoe: Great. For the KPI note: two bullets: 1) transient webhook 502 + ingestion normalization bug inflated "unknown" bucket; 2) corrected numbers uploaded, see appendix. We'll present corrected weekly KPIs.

matt: Deploy patch: normalize utm params, increase webhook retries, and alert when unknown_campaign > 1% for 15m. Deploy scheduled in 20m.

devops-bot: patch deploy started (deploy_id=ddb-442) at 2026-03-11T09:40:00Z.

anya: Pre/post snippet for the KPI deck: pre: leads=2,050 / attrib=1,712 / unknown=338. post: leads=2,050 / attrib_adjusted=2,044 / unknown=6.

zoe: Perfect. I'll slot this into the KPI weekly slide with a one-line root cause and remediation. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
